_comment: Shared golden World IR for the Unity editor-time scene-generation pipeline (US-UB3). Consumed by the pure host placement gate (tools/verify-unity RunSceneGenTests) and the EditMode mirror (Tests/Editor/SceneGenTests.cs). The NUMERIC values (terrain size/heightmap, road points, building roles/positions/rotations, prop positions) are copied from the Godot cross-engine golden (packages/godot/addons/insimul/editor/scene/fixtures/golden-ir.json) so the placement MATH is identical across engines and can be cross-validated against golden-placement-manifest.json there. Archetype keys are Unity-native: Unity is locked to the US-UB1 five roots (building/npc/item/prop/terrain), so roads carry no archetype (default terrain.texture.road), terrain chunks resolve as terrain.chunk, and interiors / the nav root carry no binding.
